headerDisplay: Tapo Energy Monitor imports daily P110M energy history from Tapo Cloud when account credentials are configured. Simulation remains optional.
footerDisplay: Tapo email and password are saved in the Homebridge config.json for automatic re-authentication. The password is stored in plain text. MFA codes are never saved.

simulationMode.title: Simulation mode
simulationMode.description: Enable only to run an explicit simulation. Leave off to collect real P110M daily history from Tapo Cloud using the saved account credentials.

enableLocalPower.title: Read live power over local LAN
enableLocalPower.description: Read current P110M power from private LAN addresses returned by Tapo Cloud. Homebridge must be able to reach the plugs. Disable to keep cloud history only.

enableMatterMeter.title: Publish Matter Electrical Meter
enableMatterMeter.description: Requires Matter enabled on this Homebridge bridge and Homebridge 2.5.0 or later. In cloud mode publishes imported P110M energy and live power when local LAN readings are available. In simulation mode publishes the separate estimated meter.

simulatedDevices.title: Simulated devices
simulatedDevices.description: Add at least one row to explicitly start simulation. Empty list means the platform remains idle.

tapoCloudUsername.title: Tapo account email
tapoCloudUsername.description: Saved in Homebridge config.json and reused for cloud authentication.

tapoCloudPassword.title: Tapo account password
tapoCloudPassword.description: Stored in plain text in Homebridge config.json. Keep the file and backups private.
